p: profitable unto God: Though man was just, yet God could not profit from this his justice; and therefore when he punished him, he had no regard to his justice, but to his sin.
of thee: Lest you should reprove or hurt him?
pledge from thy brother for nought: You have been cruel and without charity, and would do nothing for the poor, but for your own advantage.
had the earth: When you were in power and authority you did not do justice but wrong.
fatherless have been broken: You have not only not shown pity, but oppressed them.
abundance of waters cover thee: That is, manifold afflictions.
height of heaven: He accuses Job of impiety and contempt of God, as thought he would say, If you pass not for men, yet consider the height of God's majesty.
stars: That so much the more by that excellent work you may fear God, and reverence him.
know: He reproves Job, as though he denied God's providence and that he could not see the things that were done in this world.
which wicked men have trodden: How God has punished them from the beginning?
cut down out of time: He proves God's providence by the punishment of the wicked, whom he takes away before they can bring their wicked purposes to pass.
filled their houses with good things: He answers to that which Job had said, Job 21:7 that the wicked have prosperity in this world; desiring that he might not be a partaker of the like.

and the innocent laugh them to: The just rejoice at the destruction of the wicked for two reasons, first because God shows himself judge of the world and by this means continues his honour and glory: secondly because God shows that he had care over his in that he punished their enemies.
our substance is not cut down: That is, the state and preservation of the godly, is hid under God's wings.
them the fire consumeth: Meaning of the wicked.
with him: He exhorts Job to repentance, and to return to God.
be built up: God will restore to you all your substance.
dust: Which will be in abundance like dust.
light shall shine upon thy ways: That is, the favour of God.
When men are cast down: God will deliver his when the wicked are destroyed round about them, as in the flood and in Sodom.
island of the innocent: God will deliver a whole country from peril, even for the just man's sake.
